reasoning: The opening permission in the FSF's GNU FDL 1.3 plaintext expressly allows anyone to copy and distribute the license document verbatim and excludes changes to it. Section 1 gives the defined term Document a different referent: a manual or other work bearing the copyright holder's licensing notice. For copies of that work, §2 requires reproduction of the license, copyright notices and actual license notice, prohibits additional conditions and restricts technical measures that obstruct reading or further copying.
